Evan —

Appreciate the packet. Quick checklist from our side so we can align:
1) Confirm legal name matches W9 — looks good.
2) We need a bank-attested letter with the account ending in the last four (you provided — thanks).
3) For production remits we require at minimum: invoice_number, PO (if present), remit_reference; we also accept optional customer_account. Your csv sample is ideal.

Two questions before we kick off vendor activation:
- Do you prefer us to send a $1 micro-deposit for ACH confirmation or a $100 test wire? Micro-deposit is faster for ACH-only rails; wire confirms wire routing and beneficiary name.
- Do you have any preferred invoice labels for our PO system? (If you send the PO example we can map fields to our invoice_label column.)

I'll loop in Marissa on the PO mapping and Jonas on payments schedule. If you confirm the test type we will request a remittance testing window on our VPS and schedule the activation.

Best,
Irene
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Evan
